integration.description:
Mutations for notification integrations,
to enable integration with third-party services e.g. via APIs or webhooks.
integration.name: integration

definition.description:
Modified parameters for an existing webhook integration.
Specified fields will be updated, and no changes to other fields.
To remove all members, provide an empty list as the parameter.

auth.description: Update the authentication configuration for the target service.
auth.name: auth

definition.description:
Authentication configuration for updating a webhook integration.
Only one authentication method should be provided.
If null, no authentication will be used.
definition.name: UpdateWebhookAuthInput

body.description:
Update the JSON body template.
Use available fields with '$' prefix to define the webhook payload.
See 'Understanding the JSON Fields for Alert Integrations' Knowledge Base
article for details.
body.name: body

headerToAdd.description: Add headers to the webhook headers list.
headerToAdd.name: headerToAdd

headerToRemove.description: Remove headers from the webhook headers list.
headerToRemove.name: headerToRemove

relatedWebhookRef.description: Related webhook that provides the Correlation ID used for updates
relatedWebhookRef.name: relatedWebhookRef

by.description:
Specify the webhook integration by name or by ID.
IDs are automatically unique, if you use a non-unique name,
it will result in an error.
by.name: by

requestMethod.description: Update the HTTP method used when sending the webhook request (e.g., POST, PUT).
requestMethod.name: requestMethod

responseMapping.description:
Defines JSON path mappings used to extract values from the webhook response payload.
At present, only a single mapping is supported, with the key "correlationId".
The value must be a valid JSON path pointing to the field in the response payload that represents the correlation identifier (for example, result.sys_id).
responseMapping.name: responseMapping

responseMappingToAdd.description: Add response mappings to the webhook response mapping list.
responseMappingToAdd.name: responseMappingToAdd

responseMappingToRemove.description: Remove response mappings from the webhook response mapping list.
responseMappingToRemove.name: responseMappingToRemove

url.description: Update the URL of the target service
url.name: url

definition.name: UpdateWebhookInput

definition.description: Response payload for a webhook update operation.

Defines the structure of a webhook integration used to
send notifications to third-party services.

body.description: JSON template used to structure the webhook request body.
body.name: body

enabled.description: Indicates whether the webhook is currently enabled.
enabled.name: enabled

header.description: Optional custom headers sent with the webhook request.
header.name: header

id.description: Unique identifier of the webhook integration.
id.name: id

name.description: Display name of the webhook integration.
name.name: name

relatedWebhookId.description: Related webhook that provides the Correlation ID used for updates
relatedWebhookId.name: relatedWebhookId

requestMethod.description: HTTP method used when sending the webhook request (e.g., POST, PUT).
requestMethod.name: requestMethod

responseMapping.description:
Defines JSON path mappings used to extract values from the webhook response payload.
At present, only a single mapping is supported, with the key "correlationId".
The value must be a valid JSON path pointing to the field in the response payload that represents the correlation identifier (for example, result.sys_id).
responseMapping.name: responseMapping

url.description: Target URL where the webhook sends requests.
url.name: url
